source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Teach community members to recognize mental-health or substance-use challenges, provide initial support, and help connect the person with appropriate care.","B":"Teach community members to diagnose psychiatric disorders and select definitive treatment plans independently.","C":"Train nonclinicians to replace professional services by providing ongoing psychotherapy and medication management.","D":"Teach participants to avoid responding until a licensed clinician is physically present."}}
source_row.rationale: Mental Health First Aid teaches participants to recognize signs of mental health or substance-use challenges, provide initial support, and help connect people with appropriate professional care. The program explicitly does not train participants to diagnose or replace professional treatment.
source_row.source_detail: MHFA teaches recognition, response, first-level support, and connection to appropriate care; First Aiders do not diagnose or replace professional help. Source has no separate formal version identifier in the cited page metadata; live currentness and applicability rechecked 2026-08-15.
